info.title: Hugging Face Hub API
info.description: A focused slice of the Hugging Face Hub API: models, datasets, Spaces, papers, collections and users (read operations). Cut from https://huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.json; the model, dataset and Space list/info endpoints come from spec/supplement.json because the published file does not include them.

get.description: Search and list models on the Hub. Documented at https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/api.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by a substring of the repo id.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter by tag, for example a library, task or language tag.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Property to sort by, for example downloads, likes, trendingScore, createdAt or lastModified.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Return the full record for each result.
